title: Admin Directory: show representative photoPath as text with click-to-open full photo modal (no lazy loading)

requirements.summary: Replace all representative photo thumbnails in Admin Directory list/table views with readable photoPath/filename text.
acceptanceCriteria: In Admin Directory list/table views, no thumbnails are rendered for representative photos; only the filename/photoPath text is shown for each entry.
The displayed text is readable and clearly indicates it is the photo reference (e.g., the stored path/filename).

file_operations.description: Update Admin Directory list/table rendering to remove any representative photo thumbnail rendering and instead display the stored photoPath string as readable text for every leader/representative photo reference (PM/CM/MP/MLA/administrator entries). Ensure the text is styled as a clear photo reference (e.g., monospace, truncated with tooltip/title where appropriate).

requirements.summary: Open a modal overlay with the full-size photo when an admin clicks a representative photoPath text in Admin Directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a photo filename/text opens an overlay modal on top of the Admin Directory page.
The modal displays the corresponding full image and includes an obvious close control (e.g., an X button) and supports closing via ESC and clicking the backdrop.
Closing the modal returns the admin to the same scroll position/state on the Admin Directory page.

file_operations.description: Create a focused modal/overlay component for viewing a representative photo at full size. It should accept the selected photoPath and open/close state, render the resolved image, include a visible close control, and support ESC + backdrop click to close while preserving the underlying Admin Directory page state (no navigation). Use the blob-storage hook(s) to resolve the photo URL for the provided photoPath. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the photoPath text in the Admin Directory list/table rows to open RepresentativePhotoModal with the clicked entry's photoPath. Add state to track the selected photoPath, pass open/close handlers, and ensure close returns the user to the same in-page state (do not change routes).

requirements.summary: Avoid lazy-loading behavior for representative photos; only resolve/load the image when the modal is opened.
acceptanceCriteria: No lazy-loading component/behavior is introduced for representative photos on Admin Directory.
The photo URL resolution and image load happens only after the admin clicks the filename/text to open the modal (not during initial directory render).

file_operations.description: Ensure Admin Directory does not render any images for representative photos in the list/table and does not import/use LazyImage or any IntersectionObserver-based image loading for representative photos. Only pass a non-empty photoPath to the modal after click so photo URL resolution does not occur during initial directory render.

Gate photo URL resolution and rendering on the modal being open and having a valid photoPath (e.g., avoid resolving a URL until opened). Do not implement any intersection-observer-based behavior; rely on modal open state only. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
